name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 196 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 19% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 196 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 19 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Militant forces were engaged by security troops in Manipur, resulting in a militant killed and a suspected KCP-PWG cadre killed, with eight suspects apprehended. In Kashmir, Bhupender Singh took over as IG of the BSF, the lieutenant governor chaired a high-level security and administrative review for the Jammu division, and Amit Shah called for the elimination of terror, organised crime and drugs at an NIA conference. Army commanders reviewed operational preparedness in Poonch and LoC areas, while civilian casualties occurred when a driver was killed in a vehicle skidding accident in Bandipora. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Militante styrker ble engasjert av sikkerhetstroppene i Manipur, noe som resulterte i at en militant ble drept og en mistenkt KCP-PWG-kader ble drept, med åtte mistenkte pågrepet. I Kashmir overtok Bhupender Singh som IG for BSF, guvernøren ledet en høy-nivå sikkerhets‑ og administrasjonsgjennomgang for Jammu-divisjonen, og Amit Shah oppfordret til å utrydde terror, organisert kriminalitet og narkotika på en NIA-konferanse. Hæroperatører gjennomgikk operasjonell beredskap i Poonch‑ og LoC-områdene, mens sivile tap inntraff da en sjåfør ble drept i en kjøretøy-skliulykke i Bandipora. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
